name: Greensoul (Verdant Oread)
body:
The base racial traits for oreads are rooted in their ancestry tied to the spirits of the earth. While most are drawn from spirits of stone, others draw power from the leaf, root, and stalk that sprout forth from the good, green earth.

Typical Alignment N
Ability Score Modifiers +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Int
Alternate Spell-Like Ability Greensouls gain harvest seasonHotS as a spell-like ability. Greensoul oreads are affine to the earth that bears fruit- maybe plant creatures or fey intermingled with their genealogy in the past as well as elemental creatures. They tend to prefer the solitude of woods to the company of animals and humanoids and may have problems to understand the subtleties of sentient races’ societies. Greensoul oreads most often choose careers that allow them to stay in contact with nature, becoming rangers, druids, hunters, shifters, or natureoriented shamans, clerics, or bards. Their complexion, and their hair or eyes colors, can go from the deep brown of plowed soil or bark to all the nuances of green to the incredible variety of flowers. They can be shy or very vain and talkative and favor temporary tattoos and clothes in all the colors of nature.
Verdant Insight: Greensoul nature-oriented spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes plants more willing to serve them. Summon nature’s ally spells that such oreads cast last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the plant type (using the Summon Plant Ally feat). This racial trait replaces earth affinity.
Oread Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist: Add +1/2 to the alchemist’s acid bomb damage or +1/2 to the alchemist’s level when using the solid ground discovery.
Barbarian: Add +1/6 to the barbarian’s damage reduction ability. The barbarian must be 7th level before selecting this ability. This does not stack with the increased damage reduction rage power.
Brawler: Add 1/4 to the brawler’s effective level to determine her unarmed strike damage.
Cavalier: Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of the cavalier’s mount. If the cavalier ever replaces his mount, the new mount gains this bonus.
Hunter: Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of the hunter’s animal companion. If the hunter ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains this bonus.
Skald: Add +1/3 to the bonus the skald grants her allies with his inspired rage ability.
Sorcerer: Choose a bloodline power from the shaitan or elemental (earth) bloodline that the sorcerer can use. The sorcerer treats her class level as though it were +1/2 higher (to a maximum of +4) when determining the effects of that power.
Warpriest: Add 1/2 to the number of times per day the warpriest can use blessings, but he can use these additional blessings on only those from the Artifice, Destruction, Earth, Protection, Strength, or War domains.
Harvest Season

School abjuration; Level druid 2, shaman 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, M

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one plant
Duration instantaneous; see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cause an explosive burst of growth in a single plant, causing it to grow through a cycle of flower, fruit, or grain production as appropriate. If the plant is not one that normally produces food fit for humanoid consumption, it produces edible flowers under the effect of this spell. The plant produces enough food to nourish one Medium creature per caster level. Food harvested through this spell rots if not eaten within 24 hours. This spell nourishes, fertilizes, and pollinates the plant, and doesn’t harm the plant in any way.

This spell has no effect on plant creatures.

Summon Plant Ally

You can call plant creatures to your aid in battle.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nature) 1 rank, ability to cast summon nature’s ally spells.

Benefit(s): When casting a summon nature’s ally spell, you gain access to the list of plant creatures below.

Summon nature’s ally I: leaf leshy, vegepygmy
Summon nature’s ally II: gourd leshy, leaf ray (without seed ability)
Summon nature’s ally III: fungus leshy, weedwhip
Summon nature’s ally IV: assassin vine, seaweed leshy (without air cyst ability).
Summon nature’s ally V: mandragora, shambling mound.
Summon nature’s ally VI: tendriculos, treant.
Summon nature’s ally VII: giant flytrap
Summon nature’s ally VIII: jinmenju
Summon nature’s ally IX: alraune
